751-3286-5223.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2324-2415-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1981-2324-2415-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Proper Burial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7231-8095.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X creature cards in all graveyards.
6972-7231-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Drakestown Forgotten.
When Drakestown Forgotten dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

654-1308-2557-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2279-3240-5256-6462.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1339-4279-7399.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-4279-7399.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2457-3129-4289-4460.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3525-6788-7280.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
3525-6788-7280.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
3525-6788-7280.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

4771-5220-6900-7286.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

628-2981-7219.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Megatog ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6730-6972.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2292-6730-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the additional creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Sin from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As Sin enters, remove the -1/-1 counter from the creature sacrificed in step 1, causing Sin to enter with a +1/+1 counter on it instead.
Resolve the second Sin trigger, putting the counters it had on it when it was sacrificed onto a creature you control and failing to shuffle it into your library as it's no longer in your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 4.
Repeat.

586-4594-7070.description:
Activate Spirit en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Gix.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Priest of Gix.
The Spirit en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1879-4871-7072.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

1477-1492-2866-4986.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1477-1492-2866-4986.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Extruder ability
Repeat.

1414-2854-4574-6900.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1414-2854-4574-6900.description:
Cast Lotus Petal either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

38-2173-2403-5220.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

280-5451-5478-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
280-5451-5478-5702.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters untapped due to Spelunking, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

560-955-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

5329-5475-6558.notablePrerequisites:
Naga Fleshcrafter on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Naga Fleshcrafter do not have summoning sickness.
5329-5475-6558.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Naga Fleshcrafter.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Naga Fleshcrafter.
Activate Naga Fleshcrafter by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

783-2196-2821-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
783-2196-2821-5803.description:
Activate Jungle Basin and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Jungle Basin and another land.
Activate Jungle Basin and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

1274-1818-2034-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1818-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3899-4659.notablePrerequisites: Spawning Pit has at least two charge counters on it.
1270-3899-4659.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating three 2/2 Spawn artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Spawn, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing two Spawns, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2438-2517-4681-5276.notablePrerequisites: Parallax Wave has at least one fade counter on it.
2438-2517-4681-5276.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, exiling Parallax Wave.
When Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Parallax Wave from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability,  putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Parallax Wave trigger from step 5, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

146-169-2584.description:
Cast Pact of the Titan choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times, paying a total of {0}.
Pact of the Titan's replicate ability triggers, causing you to copy Pact of the Titan for each time the replicate cost was paid.
Resolve the first Pact of the Titan, creating a 4/4 Giant creature token.
When the Giant enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, dealing damage equal to the Giant's power to any target.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Pact of the Titan.

803-1520-1806-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies as a Vampire due to Arcane Adaptation, Timothar triggers, causing you to pay {1} and exile Eternal Scourge to create a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Bat, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

549-4365-4853-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure token, creating four 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}{W}.
Activate Mondrak by paying {1}{W}{W} and sacrificing two Constructs.
When the Constructs die, Dross Scorpion triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the second Dross Scorpion trigger from step 7, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Mondrak ability from step 6, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.

369-772-5256.notablePrerequisites: Shade's Form attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-772-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Iridescent Drake's power.
Repeat.

4365-4659-5320.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.
4365-4659-5320.description:
Use Krark-Clan Ironworks to sacrifice another creature, or sacrifice a permanent by any other method.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens due to Mondrak.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Sorcerer's Broom tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers twice, and each Sorcerer's Broom token triggers once.
Resolve all but one trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final trigger, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
4365-4659-5320.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Krark-Clan Ironworks, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).

1600-2302-2702.notablePrerequisites: The same color chosen with Painter's Servant and Teferi's Moat.
1600-2302-2702.description:
Teferi's Moat prevents creatures of the chosen color without flying from attacking you.
Because Painter's Servant makes all creatures the chosen color, and Archetype of Imaginaton causes all creatures your opponents control to lose flying, no creatures can attack you.

1059-1283-2011.notablePrerequisites:
Najeela does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other creatures that can attack this turn.
1059-1283-2011.description:
Declare Radha, Najeela, and at least three other creatures as attackers.
Radha and Najeela trigger.
Resolve the Radha trigger, adding at least {5}.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Najeela by paying {5}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1183-2757-3129.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pentavus, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate a basic land you control by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Pentavite creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Pentavite, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate a basic land you control by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate Pentavus' second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Pentavite, putting two +1/+1 counters on Pentavus.
Repeat from step 3.

864-2665-3617.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Eternal Witness.
864-2665-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness.
When the token Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
